arguments.name: Animation Inbetween Probes
arguments.description: Check-tier gate on a shot's render step: on the figure-only frames and the joints dump, the lead wrist, head and root travel on arcs, the drawings ease in and out, secondaries land after the primary, and holds move; a linear tween is refused.
arguments.subject: animation-inbetween-probes
arguments.guidance: Ground truth by exit code (D81). The probe runs `python3 scripts/animation/probe-inbetweens.py --all v3/poses --frames-root out --joints-root out` in the renderer root: for every pose sheet it reads `out/<shot>-figure-seq/` (the figure-only composition rendered as a png sequence, `--props='{"captions":false}'`) and `out/<shot>-joints.json` (`npm run joints -- <shot>`), skips a shot with neither and fails when none ran. Its first lines are its controls. On FAIL quote the line naming the joint and frames (a straight path, even spacing, a snapped secondary, a frozen hold) and fix the pose sheet or the breakdown poses, never the probe. Control: a linear lerp between two keys is refused.
